nodes.label: Graveyard / Memory Garden MiniApp
nodes.rationale: Framed as a warm privacy-first ritual rather than a generic contract form so that irreversible paid on-chain actions are surrounded by deliberate review; app id miniapp-graveyard, Neo N3 TestNet only.

nodes.label: Graveyard TestNet contract 0xb55aa635b10a5abb5cbac169db26a38df739778e
nodes.rationale: Only TestNet is advertised in the committed manifest; no MainNet deployment is claimed. Network magic 894710606.

nodes.label: addEpitaph(memoryId, epitaph)
nodes.rationale: Charges no Graveyard deposit but is still a signed Neo invocation that can carry a normal network fee; copy deliberately says 'no Graveyard deposit' instead of 'free'.

nodes.label: forgetMemory(owner, memoryId)
nodes.rationale: Forgetting does not erase the event log or content hash; it records a permanent forgotten state in the existing audit trail.

nodes.label: getPlatformStats (Graveyard live fee read)
nodes.rationale: Live fees are read rather than hardcoded so the 0.1/1 GAS display seeds can never authorize a stale-fee transfer.

nodes.label: getMemoryDetails readback
nodes.rationale: Epitaph success requires an exact getMemoryDetails readback in addition to the event, because a relayed transaction ID or event alone is not proof of canonical state.

nodes.label: On-device SHA-256 digest privacy boundary
nodes.rationale: Notes and files are hashed locally with Web Crypto so raw text and file bytes never reach the network or the contract; only a 64-character digest is accepted for a paid burial, files capped at 25 MB. The app explicitly does not encrypt, store, upload or destroy the original, and offers no TEE key destruction.

nodes.label: Device-local prepaid-credit recovery journal
nodes.rationale: A GAS deposit can confirm while the consuming contract call fails; the journal restores digest/type and reuses that prepaid credit through a direct retry instead of charging a second deposit. It never stores note text or file bytes and must complete a local-storage round trip before any wallet write opens.

nodes.label: Fail-closed live fee + isPaused write-readiness gate
nodes.rationale: Fee and pause reads form a single gate; a paused or unreadable contract blocks payment before any GAS transfer, and a failed fee read disables review with an explicit retry rather than falling back to a seeded fee.

nodes.label: Exact event identity matching before state change
nodes.rationale: A matching event name alone could belong to another owner or payload, so memory id, owner, digest, memory type and epitaph text must all agree with the reviewed action before local state changes.

nodes.label: Empty public operation panel
nodes.rationale: The manifest exposes no generic parameter operations so the platform host cannot rebuild the ritual as a duplicate survey-like form detached from source, live fee, confirmation and recovery state.

nodes.label: Wallet-scoped record clearing on owner switch
nodes.rationale: Previous owner records are cleared before the replacement read starts so an RPC failure cannot leave another wallet's history visible.

nodes.label: Graveyard bilingual boundary documentation
nodes.rationale: The Chinese README mirrors the English contract, privacy, fee, permanence and recovery boundaries verbatim so neither locale can overclaim behavior the other denies.

nodes.label: Memory Garden design system
nodes.rationale: Warm limestone/ivory surfaces, forest-moss primary action, bronze/amber detail, Georgia for memorial moments and monospace only for hashes; one garden stage, one ritual surface, one compact review rail, progressively disclosed records. Replaces five equal text pills that made the app read as a form.

nodes.label: Confirmation review sheet boundary
nodes.rationale: The previous UI called executeDestroy directly with no deliberate review boundary; only the review sheet's final button now dispatches the paid call, keyboard focus is trapped and restored, and any digest/type/fee change invalidates the prior confirmation.

nodes.label: Persistent mobile fee visibility
nodes.rationale: Mobile CSS previously hid the fee/review region so a paid action could be reached without seeing its cost; fee, wallet, digest and permanence now stay in the main mobile path at every breakpoint.

nodes.label: Readiness derived from a completed digest
nodes.rationale: Readiness was previously derived from raw draft presence, producing a false-ready state while SHA-256 had not completed; it now requires an actual 64-character digest and exposes hashing progress.

nodes.label: App-owned prepaid-credit retry lane
nodes.rationale: A prepaid transfer followed by a failed consuming call previously had no retry lane, so retrying could add a second deposit or lose context after refresh; a device-local wallet/operation journal now records deposit and target broadcast phases and recovery invokes directly against existing credit. forgetMemory also now rejects unless requestForget already confirmed the exact row, so the action wrapper cannot emit a success toast for a no-op.

nodes.label: Graveyard concept-to-render fidelity ledger
nodes.rationale: Each concept comparison point (hierarchy, memory source, artifact treatment, memory tokens, contrast, fee hierarchy, responsive first viewport, confirmation state) is judged against render evidence at 390x844 and 1280x900.

nodes.label: Pending visual sign-off gate (IAB unavailable)
nodes.rationale: The in-app browser binding was unavailable and Playwright/Chrome were deliberately not substituted, so functional and static checks pass but a fresh same-viewport screenshot comparison remains required before platform-wide visual sign-off.

nodes.label: public/memory-garden.webp
nodes.rationale: Generated with OpenAI ImageGen on 2026-07-11 specifically for this miniapp, resized to 1440x1080 and encoded as WebP quality 86 with Sharp; serves as the primary garden environment scene.

nodes.label: public/memory-letter.webp
nodes.rationale: Generated paper/wax-seal artifact at 1440x810, WebP quality 88; it carries the real textarea/file/hash controls rather than being decorative.

nodes.label: Graveyard generated-art provenance record
nodes.rationale: No stock imagery or third-party visual asset was added; pre-existing logo/banner and the legacy memory-vault-stage.webp are explicitly not claimed as newly generated work.

nodes.label: Graveyard production verification evidence
nodes.rationale: 49/49 focused logic/PlayArea/integration tests, 1,848-module build with React/UI/platform-SDK/crypto vendor splits, 17/17 static HTTP 200, byte-identical dist copied to the host miniapp directory, host catalog 77 entries with miniapp-graveyard at 1.1.0. Browser screenshot comparison explicitly not claimed.

nodes.label: Graveyard Vite entry (#app / src/main.tsx)
nodes.rationale: Standard platform shell: viewport-fit=cover plus apple-mobile-web-app meta for the framed host, logo.webp favicon and banner.webp og:image feeding the catalog.

nodes.label: Memorial Shrine MiniApp
nodes.rationale: A public Neo N3 remembrance garden where garden, portrait and fixed-price symbolic offerings are primary; creation details, history and transaction recovery stay in a secondary drawer.

nodes.label: MiniAppMemorialShrine contract
nodes.rationale: MainNet 0xee7a548b71c69364fcb0e45a63a40f141b938e42 and TestNet 0x87f0fe2ba69cd973a3274471234d3cc13ef943c5. The repository does not contain the deployed source, so deployed ABI/state is the runtime source of truth.

nodes.label: payTribute
nodes.rationale: A tribute records an on-chain symbolic offering through the deployed contract's payment path; the UI deliberately does not claim GAS is sent to a family.

nodes.label: onNEP17Payment tribute lane
nodes.rationale: TestNet tributes use the deployed payment-plus-invocation lane through the framework payment path.

nodes.label: paymentHub getter
nodes.rationale: MainNet tribute is blocked before wallet interaction because the deployed paymentHub returned null/unconfigured; a configured and verified hub is a release prerequisite.

nodes.label: onTransactionSent SDK callback binding
nodes.rationale: Every write is bound to the exact network, contract, wallet, intent, amount and transaction ID observed by onTransactionSent, so recovery can never guess which broadcast it is checking.

nodes.label: HALT + exact event + authoritative readback verification
nodes.rationale: A write completes only when getapplicationlog reports HALT, the exact contract event matches the saved intent, and authoritative contract getters agree. FAULT, unavailable/unknown, event mismatch and readback-pending are kept as separate states, and failed integer reads stay unavailable rather than becoming synthetic zeros.

nodes.label: Durable pending-write recovery record
nodes.rationale: The broadcast record is round-tripped through local storage before recovery is treated as available and a failed storage preflight blocks the wallet request; refresh restores and checks the pending write but never replays the invocation.

nodes.label: RPC failure distinguished from an empty garden
nodes.rationale: Reads come directly from MiniAppMemorialShrine getters; an RPC failure is shown as a recoverable unavailable state so users are never told a populated garden is empty.

nodes.label: HTTPS/IPFS photo reference boundary
nodes.rationale: The photo field stores only a URL or CID reference; the MiniApp does not upload files, offer private memorials, manage collaborators, or issue a NEP-11 token.

nodes.label: getOfferingCost (six fixed offering prices)
nodes.rationale: Observed Fixed8 values 1,000,000 / 2,000,000 / 3,000,000 / 5,000,000 / 10,000,000 / 50,000,000 define the six contract-defined symbolic offerings the UI presents.

nodes.label: MainNet/TestNet tribute ABI divergence
nodes.rationale: MainNet payTribute takes 5 parameters including receiptId and has no onNEP17Payment, while TestNet payTribute takes 4 and exposes onNEP17Payment plus offerIncense; the frontend therefore drives two different write lanes from one codebase.

nodes.label: Read-only N3Index deployment snapshot
nodes.rationale: Only getversion/getblockcount/getcontractstate/invokefunction were called; no wallet was opened and nothing was signed, broadcast or deployed. Block counts are observation points, not pinned release heights.

nodes.label: Memorial Shrine release gates
nodes.rationale: Three gates block release: unconfigured MainNet paymentHub, incomplete asset provenance clearance, and the absence of any funded signer acceptance run. Frontend recovery and confirmation integrity are implemented but the app is explicitly not yet production-ready.

nodes.label: Phase-driven motion with no fake transaction timer
nodes.rationale: Motion is driven by real preparing, broadcast, checking and readback phases so progress feedback cannot imply confirmation the chain has not given.

nodes.label: Memorial Shrine asset distribution clearance gate
nodes.rationale: Repository history proves when memorial-garden.webp, shrine-scene-art.webp, banner.webp and logo.webp entered the codebase but not the legal right to distribute them; no per-file author, source URL or license was found, and presence in git is explicitly not treated as an inferred license.

nodes.label: Milestone Escrow MiniApp
nodes.rationale: A Neo N3 escrow workbench for funding a project once and releasing NEO or GAS tranche by tranche; presented as a milestone-funded workspace rather than a long setup form.

nodes.label: MiniAppMilestoneEscrow contract 0x442162de25008ac78d4cce62ed8d8a64401b7ece
nodes.rationale: The same address and NEF checksum 447355561 are deployed on both MainNet and TestNet with a 28-method ABI.

nodes.label: createEscrow(creator, beneficiary, asset, totalAmount, milestoneAmounts, title, notes)
cancelEscrow(creator, escrowId)
nodes.rationale: Cancellation is allowed only while no approved-but-unclaimed milestone exists, and refunds only the remaining balance.

nodes.label: Two-signature deposit-then-create flow
nodes.rationale: Creation needs the token deposit signature first and createEscrow only after that deposit confirms; a deposit broadcast is never treated as a created escrow, which is exactly why an unconsumed deposit needs a withdrawal path.

nodes.label: Legacy-deployment fail-closed creation policy
nodes.rationale: Because the live 28-method build cannot withdraw a deposit that confirms while createEscrow fails, the frontend refuses to request a new deposit signature while still permitting recovery-critical approve/claim/cancel on existing escrows. This is framed as a contract deployment prerequisite, not a frontend test failure.

nodes.label: directAssetCreditOf (not deployed)
nodes.rationale: Present in the local recovery-capable build (checksum 1925478399) but absent from both live deployments; a direct probe returns FAULT.

nodes.label: Zero-based UI to one-based contract index conversion
nodes.rationale: The UI selects milestones from zero but the contract indexes from one, so every approve/claim call converts before invoking and verifies the returned event index after.

nodes.label: Off-chain evidence and dispute boundary
nodes.rationale: The deployed contract stores tranche amounts, approvals, claims, parties, title and notes but has no evidence store and no dispute arbiter, so the UI shows the original acceptance brief while never presenting off-chain files as verified.

nodes.label: NEO/GAS precision and minimum rules
nodes.rationale: NEO is indivisible and GAS uses 8 decimals converted without floating point; minimum total is 1 NEO or 0.1 GAS and all 1-12 tranche amounts are revalidated immediately before signing.

nodes.label: Milestone Escrow manifest permissions
nodes.rationale: invoke:primary for contract writes, read:blockchain for the escrow ledger, and NEP-17 payments for the initial NEO or GAS deposit.

nodes.label: getPlatformStats (escrow business limits)
nodes.rationale: Returns totalEscrows, totalLocked, totalReleased, minNeo=1, minGas=10000000, minMilestones=1, maxMilestones=12 — the live source of the frontend's pre-write business-limit check.

nodes.label: Read-only TestNet ABI probe result
nodes.rationale: Verified through testnet1/testnet2.neo.coz.io with no wallet transaction: 28 ABI methods, isPaused HALT false, and the three recovery methods confirmed missing with a FAULT on direct invocation.

nodes.label: Milestone Escrow creation-reopen release gate
nodes.rationale: Reopening new escrow creation requires deploying the recovery-capable contract, independently verifying ABI and checksum on the target network, running the full deposit/create/reclaim/approve/claim/cancel/30-day lifecycle, and updating this status file plus the manifest deployment reason.

nodes.label: MiniApp Studio (miniapp-factory)
nodes.rationale: Production-complete for deterministic starter-package creation and explicit testnet registry handoff; the primary journey is choose experience, name app, generate package, register testnet record, operator handoff.

nodes.label: Registry-record-only product boundary
nodes.rationale: MiniApp Factory writes a registry record; it does not deploy an app or a contract and never reports that outcome. Finished PlayArea implementation and catalog publication remain explicit operator steps.

nodes.label: Deterministic starter package bundle
nodes.rationale: Generates a catalog patch, starter manifest, Factory binding, exact registration plan and one exportable JSON bundle so the handoff is reproducible rather than conversational.

nodes.label: createMiniAppFromTemplate (single primary write)
nodes.rationale: Called only after a fresh template read and exact testnet/network checks; intent is stored before wallet approval and the Factory record is read back without converting RPC failure into success.

nodes.label: getTemplate (registration gate)
nodes.rationale: A live read gates registration so unknown and unregistered templates never enable the write.

nodes.label: Schema-versioned local draft recovery
nodes.rationale: Drafts are normalized on restore and old persisted network values are forced back to the configured testnet, so a stale draft cannot silently retarget a different network.

nodes.label: MiniApp Factory registry 0x03a7c8fc724a575ee739c919ed52cb5e2a2bdc49
nodes.rationale: Only neo-n3-testnet is declared because this is the sole configured Factory registry in the release.

nodes.label: getMiniAppIdByIndex(index)
nodes.rationale: Together with miniAppCount it forms the registry enumeration ABI used by the history drawer.

nodes.label: HasArtifact=false terminal-state rule
nodes.rationale: All four templates report HasArtifact=false, which is expected for a record-only lane; the app must never translate it into 'application deployed' — its confirmed terminal state is only 'Factory registry record confirmed'.

nodes.label: miniapp-launch-studio.webp
nodes.rationale: 1672x941 main creation-stage artwork showing the four template workstations, loaded by src/PlayArea.tsx; SHA-256 pinned so source and dist can be proved byte-identical.

nodes.label: Repository-local visual asset rule
nodes.rationale: All production visuals are repository-local and the runtime loads no artwork from third-party hosts; nothing is copied from the IcedSoul/minigame-everyday game reference repository, which is not an appropriate source for an application-creation utility.

nodes.label: neo:miniapp host discovery meta tags
nodes.rationale: Declares neo:miniapp:id=miniapp-miniapp-factory, name, entry /miniapps/miniapp-factory/index.html, onegate=true and the params list (operation, network, owner, appId, name, templateKind) so the platform host can resolve and deep-link the app.

nodes.label: Neo Convert MiniApp
nodes.rationale: A tools MiniApp: key generation, WIF/private/public-key conversion, Neo N3 address decoding and NeoVM script disassembly, all in the browser process.

nodes.label: No-contract, no-write-path boundary
nodes.rationale: Neo Convert has no MiniApp contract and never asks the wallet to sign. Contract binding, event confirmation, state readback, pending-operation persistence and transaction recovery are declared not applicable, because inventing those behaviors would misrepresent the product.

nodes.label: Neo Convert manifest declaration
nodes.rationale: Declares both neo-n3-mainnet and neo-n3-testnet, an empty contracts map, transactions:false, only the read-blockchain permission, and deliberately no static stateSource because a fixed endpoint would misdescribe the other supported network.

nodes.label: Optional wallet balance snapshot
nodes.rationale: Reads raw NEO/GAS base units for the connected address and discards the response if the wallet address changed in flight; balance observers act only as invalidation signals so number-backed observer values cannot introduce display rounding.

nodes.label: public/key-workbench-stage.webp
nodes.rationale: 1672x941 workbench stage regenerated with OpenAI ImageGen on 2026-07-11; the redraw removes a pseudo-token mark in favor of a neutral keyhole/circuit seal and makes decorative code/QR surfaces non-scannable so the art cannot be mistaken for a real token or payload.

nodes.label: Shared CoinArt official token art
nodes.rationale: Official Neo Press Kit NEO/GAS images live in apps/shared/assets/tokens and render through apps/shared/art/CoinArt.tsx; per-app NEO/GAS drawings, emoji, CSS/div illustration and inline SVG token art are forbidden.

nodes.label: Git custody is not a license claim
nodes.rationale: Retained logo and legacy artwork lack original generation/source terms; git history proves project custody, not the original provider terms, so redistribution under a new license claim must resolve those terms first.

hyperedges.label: Graveyard burial ritual: digest, review, fee gate, deposit, event verification, recovery
Shared verified-write pattern: broadcast journal, exact event identity, authoritative readback, fail-closed before signing
